Dialog.Title: Loot — {name}
Dialog.ChooseLooterHint: Choose which character makes the skill roll and/or receives the loot.

DM.Title: LootForge — DM Review
DM.SaveAndCloseHint: Save & Close (or Close) releases this loot so any player can double-click the corpse to open the loot window.

Player.Title: Loot
Player.DoubleClickHint: Double-click an item to take it. Closing leaves leftovers for everyone — open loot windows stay in sync.

RequireInvestigationRoll.Name: Require Investigation roll
RequireInvestigationRoll.Hint: Legacy setting — Investigation is always rolled by the player.

AllowAllPlayersToLoot.Name: Allow all players to loot
AllowAllPlayersToLoot.Hint: After the GM closes DM Review, any player can double-click the corpse to loot together (live-synced). Recommended on.

AllowPlayerRequestLoot.Name: Allow players to request loot from DM
AllowPlayerRequestLoot.Hint: Legacy setting — players start Investigation by double-clicking.

PreventDuplicateGeneration.Name: Prevent duplicate generation
PreventDuplicateGeneration.Hint: Block regenerating loot on a corpse that already has generated loot.

ShowLootIndicators.Name: Show loot indicators
ShowLootIndicators.Hint: Show WoW-style white sparkles around creatures as soon as they are marked dead. Sparkles vanish and the corpse is hidden when fully looted.

EnableRareDrops.Name: Enable rare drops
EnableRareDrops.Hint: Allow uncommon rewards such as Alpha Wolf Fang.

DebugLogging.Name: Debug logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Print detailed LootForge logs to the console.

Auth.Hint: Sign in with your Gambits Forge account. LootForge requires Tier 1 or higher. Players do not need their own subscription when the GM is entitled.

ApiBaseUrl.Name: Gambits Forge API base URL
ApiBaseUrl.Hint: Backend URL for account and entitlement checks. Defaults to the production Gambits Forge API.

Debug.Name: Debug authentication logging
Debug.Hint: Log auth flow details to the console. Tokens and passwords are never printed.

Access.Title: LootForge Access
Access.Required: LootForge requires an active Gambits Forge Tier 1 or higher subscription.
Access.Expired: Your LootForge access has expired. Connect to the internet and check your subscription.
Access.NoEntitledGM: No entitled GM is available to process LootForge actions.
